Success wo hai jab tum haar se haar tak bina josh khoye chalte ho.
Yesterday se seekho, aaj jiyo, kal hope rakho.
"Disappointment process ka hissa hai."
Dimaag jo bhi soch sakta hai aur jismein vishwas kar sakta hai, use haasil kar sakta hai.
Khush raho.
"Jeet ya haar—tum yaad kiye jaoge."
Musibat ke beech mein hi avsar chipa hota hai.
"Discipline, motivation se jeet jata hai."
Impossible ko possible maan lo, ho jayega.
Decision lo, phir plan pe kaam karo.
